cofold.implementation: Boltz implementation in the DeCAF repository; not the distilled DeCAF model

p2rank.hybrid_ranking: mean zPocket probability over residues with heavy atoms within 8 A of center

processing.fit: Kabsch on corresponding CA atoms of residues with a heavy atom <5 A from probe
processing.center: mean of ligand heavy atoms within 4.5 A of protein; whole-ligand fallback

evaluation.N_plus_2: Independent-site recall within 4 A after annotation masking
evaluation.top1: First emitted suggestion; no replacement after masking; denominator includes missing/masked first suggestions
